story_text:
As a user, I want to reset my password via email so that I can regain access to my account.

AC1: Request reset with email
AC2: Receive reset link within 5 minutes
AC3: Link expires after 1 hour
AC4: New password must meet complexity rules
AC5: Old sessions invalidated after reset
AC6: Rate limit: 3 requests per hour
architecture_text: Auth module: src/auth/. Password reset via email token (JWT, 1h expiry). Rate limiting with Redis. Session invalidation via token blacklist.
